scope_and_limitations: Four fresh real adapter worlds: two predefined trajectories in each of the operating and publication templates. ConfirmGrant is compiler bootstrap plus declared public-scope establishment, not a fictional worker Confirm action.

53 checks are 31 legacy relation/local/scope checks plus 22 independent formal-confirmation expectations. The 31 comprise 11 cross-template markers, 16 world-local checks and 4 separate in-memory scope fixture checks.

Cross-template agreement is finite relation-level conformance, not business-content quality or arbitrary adapter equivalence. Operating scheduled reply and publication editor reply are compared at the declared ReviseLateReply macro boundary.
Nine measurement truth cases and three measurement mutants are reported separately in v06-measurement.json; do not add them to the 53 denominator.

normalization.aliases: Participating work by requirement revision; credentials/requests/conditions/submissions by creation order; actor by action-specific institutional role.
normalization.selected_relations: Exact credential confirmation and grant, current work/status/readiness/actions, bound condition status, recorded response and current request target, submission invalidation/applicability/decision and presence of every pinned deliverable.
normalization.excluded: Domain content, extra nonparticipating bootstrap credentials, artifact count/format, message text, numeric logical time, staff transport details (including differing outdated_reply/delivered labels). Full raw states and exact pins remain archived.
normalization.formal_confirmation: Normalize target, credential and attestation with VersionRef; require exact object/version and matching issuance links. Historical issuance is separate from current-work applicability.

protocol.timing: Operating scheduled replies run when a tool advances the clock; publication replies use editor actions. ReviseLateReply is an explicit macro boundary, not equality at every lower-level event.
protocol.bootstrap: Compilation confirms and grants the initial credentials. The revision trajectory requests and replies once before ConfirmGrant to establish equivalent public scope.
protocol.scope_fixture: A/B static scope is an independent shared-core component fixture; not an adapter trajectory or a new business template.
protocol.forbidden_harness_operations: No hidden core calls or state patches in the four adapter trajectories; no event timestamp edits.

report.interpretation: Finite agreement of specified institutional relations, not domain equivalence, quality agreement, arbitrary adapter conformance or model performance. Static A/B scope is separate state-only evidence.
